evidence: Modifies src/validation.cpp by adding invariant checks to Chainstate::MaybeUpdateMempoolForReorg.
rationale: Adds two Assume invariant checks to Chainstate::MaybeUpdateMempoolForReorg to verify that block disconnections do not evict existing transactions or drop resurrected ones. While it hardens validation invariants against regressions of CVE-2025-62861, it does not fix an active bug and is safe to defer.
